key_points: AI safety warnings and calls for slowdown weigh on tech sentiment, pulling GOOGL lower in the short term
Alphabet’s announced nuclear power contracts increase debt and may be viewed as a long‑term strategic play but add short‑term financial risk
Potential loss of AI talent to Anthropic could hinder execution on key projects
Ohio State’s reconsideration of data‑center tax breaks could pressure margins for Google’s cloud business
Overall market noise dominates; no earnings or guidance surprise, so effect is modest and likely temporary
